notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Jump at the end of Level 3 brought closer to make it easier to perform.
[*] Fixed a bug in Level 6 where the character wasn't resetting when the platform he is on moves.
[*] Lighting of the game improved.
[*] Optimization improved.
[*] Sound design improved.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved lighting.
[*] Improved optimization.
[*] Improved sound design.
[*] UI changes.
[*] Gameplay adjustments.
[*] Minor visual changes.
[*] Minor bug fix.
[/list]

Details:

- Lighting in forest area improved. Now it has better shadows, better forest feeling.
- Optimization in forest area slightly improved.
- Sounds and music of the game now have a better volume design.
- Several UI changes have been made to improve the player experience.
- Players were having a hard time understanding the last act of the game. We addressed this by changing the actors' locations to provide clear visual on what is what.
- Small visual changes provide a better general look.
- Fixed a bug where the cloud density was suddenly changing.
